trials.claim: Lifetime access to Domain Monitor Plan
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Domain Monitor Plan
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the vendor revoke access, terminate or limit the account, and change the terms at any time without notice, which materially limits the lifetime-access promise. A review thanking the seller for a lifetime deal does not override those terms.

exhibits.quote: Domain Monitor may at anytime revoke the ability for you to access your account and we may terminate your account or limit the functionality within your account if we see reasonable reason to do so.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor can revoke or terminate the account at any time.

exhibits.quote: Domain Monitor may revise these terms of service for its website at any time without notice.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime promise is undermined because terms can be changed at any time without notice.

exhibits.quote: What I would like to see for the software is the ability to record the domain provider and the dollar amount for a yearly renewal, just to keep track of expenses. Thanks for the lifetime deal.
exhibits.argument: Buyer explicitly thanks seller for the lifetime deal, confirming lifetime access was offered.

trials.claim: Plan includes 100 monitors and 100 domains monthly
trials.reasoning: Two buyers independently confirm monitoring 100 domains, outweighing one report of being stopped at 16 domains. The statement that the Pro plan starts at a minimum of 75 monitors does not contradict a 100-monitor deal plan.

exhibits.quote: Our "Pro" plan starts at a minimum of 75 monitors.
exhibits.argument: The 100 monitors claim is contradicted by the official plan starting at 75 monitors.

exhibits.quote: Monthly (100 monitors, 100 domains) in the offer, i've just been stopped adding by 16th domain.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being blocked at 16 domains despite the advertised 100 monitors and domains.

exhibits.quote: Great tool!. Very good price for 100 domains! It will be even better when we'll be able to notify clients by email for a specific domain only!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms getting 100 domains for the price, supporting the 100-domain quantity.

exhibits.quote: You can monitor 100 domains but only get 5 status pages, and if you need more, you have to pay extra monthly!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms you can monitor 100 domains, supporting the 100-domain limit.

trials.claim: All future Domain Monitor Plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Domain Monitor Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms state the vendor makes no commitment to update the materials, directly conflicting with the promise that all future plan updates are included.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to change the maximum number of domains you're allowed to add on your plan
exhibits.argument: Future updates are undermined because the vendor can reduce included limits.

exhibits.quote: However Domain Monitor does not make any commitment to update the materials.
exhibits.argument: Promise of all future updates is contradicted by no commitment to update.

trials.reasoning: The vendor states a 3-day money-back guarantee, and its terms bar refunds after 3 days, directly conflicting with the advertised 60-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: You can cancel at anytime. We have a 3-day money back guarantee!.
exhibits.argument: The 60-day guarantee is contradicted by the vendor stating only a 3-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: any subscription fees you have paid in advance will not be refunded unless there has been 3 days or less since the payment.
exhibits.argument: The 60-day guarantee is contradicted by refunds only allowed within 3 days.

trials.reasoning: A £7.99 monthly renewal price for ordinary subscribers does not prove or disprove that the deal price was $49.95 or that its stated $599 value is false, and no exhibit shows the actual deal price or value.

exhibits.quote: Our special entry offer applies to new customers for the first month's subscription. Renews at £7.99/month
exhibits.argument: The $599 anchor is misleading because the actual product is sold as a cheap monthly subscription.

trials.reasoning: The vendor's pricing page directly lists 1-min. checks as a plan feature. Warnings about initial crawling delays and data reliability do not contradict how often monitors are checked.

exhibits.quote: The crawling process may take 24 to 48 hours, during this time the information about your domain will be inaccurate.
exhibits.argument: 1-min checks are undermined because new data can be inaccurate for 24 to 48 hours.

exhibits.quote: We cannot guarantee the reliability of the data displayed against a monitor as the monitor that is being checked may not be formatted correctly or be accessible to our servers, in addition, monitoring may be unreliable in some countries.
exhibits.argument: 1-min checks are undermined because the vendor disclaims reliability of monitor data.
Vendor's official pricing page lists 1-min checks as a Pro plan feature.
